title: Polymarket unveils insider trading rules: no bets on stolen confidential info, illegal tips, or events whose outcomes the user can influence as an insider (Emily Nicolle/Bloomberg)
summary: Emily Nicolle / Bloomberg: Polymarket unveils insider trading rules: no bets on stolen confidential info, illegal tips, or events whose outcomes the user can influence as an insider — Polymarket has moved to squash some types of insider trading after the prediction markets platform came under scrutiny for suspected manipulation.
